DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

I will await the MRI results to confirm the absence of a brainstem mass, but the combination of parkinsonism (rigidity, tremor), cerebellar signs (gait ataxia, slurred speech), and severe autonomic dysfunction (orthostatic hypotension, incontinence) strongly points to this neurodegenerative disorder.
